shots.prompt: Photorealistic macro photo on a physics teacher's lab bench, no people, no hands. In the foreground, sharp: a white solderless breadboard holding a blue cylindrical electrolytic capacitor, a copper wire-wound inductor coil on a black bobbin, and a small black toggle switch, joined by short red and black jumper wires into one closed loop. Behind it, slightly soft, a small benchtop oscilloscope facing the camera; its display is a flat, evenly lit chroma-key green rectangle filling the screen edge to edge, no text, no grid, no interface, no reflections, all four corners of the display in frame. Warm late-afternoon window light from the left, dark wooden bench, shallow depth of field, 50mm, calm and clean. Leave empty bench space around the edges of the frame.
shots.why: A real circuit on a real bench, so the lesson starts from a physical thing; code can't make it look real. The scope screen is green so the ringing trace is drawn in code.

shots.prompt: Very slow, smooth push-in toward the capacitor and coil on the breadboard, nothing in the scene moves. The oscilloscope display stays a flat, evenly lit chroma-key green with no text or interface for the whole shot.
shots.why: The bench shot in motion, for the opening.

shots.prompt: Photorealistic photo of an empty high-school physics classroom before the first lesson, no people. Seen from the back row: rows of empty wooden desks and chairs lead to a large wall-mounted projector screen at the front. The projector screen is a flat, evenly lit chroma-key green rectangle, edge to edge, no text, no image, no interface, all four corners in frame. Soft morning light through tall windows on the right, a few textbooks on the desks, a periodic table poster on the side wall. Calm, quiet, 35mm, natural colour.
shots.why: The classroom where the lesson happens, without showing a person as a user; the canvas goes onto the green screen in code.

shots.prompt: Slow, steady dolly forward between the rows of empty desks toward the projector screen. The screen stays a flat, evenly lit chroma-key green with no text or image for the whole shot; dust floats in the window light.
shots.why: The room in motion, so the cut from the bench into the lesson is a move and not a slide.
